about: CI cost manifest (ci-spend law, 2026-10-11). One entry per workflow, one leg per runner OS. scripts/check_workflow_runner_cost.py fails a workflow or OS leg without an entry, an entry without a benefit, triggers/crons/jobs that differ from the workflow file, and $ that do not add up as warnings; only an undeclared paid runner fails. Spend is judged by the server spend watch (weekly total of real money vs $100), never per repo here.
prices_source: GitHub billing API pricePerUnit (Actions Linux / Windows / macOS 3-core), read 2026-10-11

ci.yml.benefit: Full extension build/lint/tests and development artifact for runtime changes; the scope job first exercises its own fail-closed classification fixtures on every push and PR, then routes proven artifact-backed stabilization documentation to tracked-document validation. The release workflow_dispatch closes the GITHUB_TOKEN recursion gap by rebuilding the exact tagged release source through the same full CI checks before producing a development artifact. macOS retains its real resource integrations and native-architecture artifact admission; portable hosted lane/CLI/admission fixtures execute in the mandatory Linux focused suite.
ci.yml.owner_reason: Before it, nothing was enforced on PRs (AUDIT P0-8).
ci.yml.basis: Conservative all-full-run forecast retains 2513 runs/week (2500 ordinary plus up to 13 release-linked exact-source runs), 3.8 Linux minutes/run including scope/docs overhead, and now 3.0 macOS minutes/run. Official run 40943680643 on 2026-10-29 used about 149 seconds for the four real Mac resource suites, then timed out in a duplicate portable acceptance corpus. Linux passed that complete mandatory corpus in 98.7 seconds. The Mac lane retains all four resource suites and actual-host architecture provenance within its unchanged 5-minute deadline. Replacing the duplicate corpus adds no runner, job, trigger, cadence, dispatch or timeout; actual incremental billed cost is $0 on public standard runners. The macOS forecast corrects the stale 1.5-minute estimate, increasing forecast by $233.71/week without adding work. Future measured savings are unclaimed. Eligible docs-only runs still skip full Linux/Mac work; forecast does not assume an eligibility share.

focused-acceptance.yml.benefit: Newest relevant main commit's focused acceptance, outside the CI queue. Manual checks validate an exact owned D47 QA tag through the same focused suite when local admission is unavailable.
focused-acceptance.yml.basis: observed 2026-10-02..09 (runs list + sampled jobs' billed minutes): 466/week x 1 min

hosted-guest-acceptance.yml.benefit: Native side-panel acceptance on a hosted Mac guest, including EXT-D-0217 retained-profile Save/Retry, EXT-D-0221 admin Screenshots T04/T05, and a focused EXT-D-0262 Settings guest admin-absence check on the existing guarded lane; no extra job or schedule.
hosted-guest-acceptance.yml.owner_reason: Extension acceptance on a real browser.
hosted-guest-acceptance.yml.basis: observed 2026-10-02..09: 288 dispatches/week x 4.8 macOS min plus one on-demand D221 Screenshots run/week. The focused D262 guest Settings check replaces a broader Settings rerun within the existing 289 on-demand runs/week. The readiness window permits two additional 15-second intervals at each of three stages; budget 1.75 extra minutes per run, including observed ~1-second/sample overhead, for all 289 runs. Advancing the exact published-CRX selector from 0.2.205 to the verified 0.2.577 artifact changes no trigger, runner, job, cadence, runtime budget, or dispatch count; incremental cost $0. Public runner billed $0. Settings guard-only diagnostics add two awaited process snapshots and journal I/O per watch, with nonzero runtime overhead; no additional dispatch, job, runner or cadence.

auth-navigation-park-macos.yml.benefit: One bounded hosted diagnostic isolates post-login web identity parking before extension Settings authentication for frozen development artifact 605.
auth-navigation-park-macos.yml.owner_reason: Resolve the known admin web identity parking failure without entering extension auth.
auth-navigation-park-macos.yml.basis: one authorized diagnostic at the existing public macos-15-intel rate, hard-bounded to one 15-minute job; maximum 0.93 USD at list price, public runner billed $0.

hosted-resource-diagnostic.yml.basis: observed 2026-10-02..09 (runs list + sampled jobs' billed minutes): 1/week x 2 macOS min

release.yml.benefit: Hosted release: publishes main and the immutable v* tag with the Store ZIP.
release.yml.basis: observed 2026-10-02..09 (runs list + sampled jobs' billed minutes): 13/week x 5 min
